lines: +# Fidelity check for rollout-engine changes — rule and rationale
+`check <run_dir>` reads Miles step dumps (`train_data/*.pt`: per sample `tokens`,
+`loss_masks`, trainer `log_probs`, engine `rollout_log_probs`) and exits 0 (safe for long
+runs) or 1 (hold), printing one reason line. It needs only Python + PyTorch on CPU:
+no weights, no tokenizer, no `/data`, no network, no writes. Runtime ~2 s for an
+8-step × 32-prompt run.
+## What the trainer assumes (from the Miles code)
+This recipe trains with `--advantage-estimator grpo` and none of `--use-tis`,
+`--use-rollout-logprobs`, `--get-mismatch-metrics`
+([losses.py](/root/miles/miles/backends/training_utils/loss_hub/losses.py)):
+the PPO ratio is trainer-current vs trainer-old log-probs; engine log-probs feed only the
+dashboard metrics. Advantages are `reward − mean(reward over the 4 samples of the prompt)`
+(±1 rewards; verified directly in the dumps). So the trainer assumes:
+1. **The 4 samples per prompt are independent draws** — otherwise the group baseline
+   degenerates (identical rewards ⇒ advantage ≡ 0 ⇒ no gradient from that prompt).
+2. **Tokens are drawn from the distribution the trainer scores** (temperature-1 softmax of
+   the current weights) — there is no importance correction, so a different sampling
+   distribution is uncorrected off-policy bias, in proportion to how far it moves.
+The gate tests (1) exactly, and (2) only for gross violations. The reasons follow.
+## What actually broke in the prefill-deterministic incident
+`--sglang-enable-prefill-only-deterministic-inference` did not shift the per-token
+distribution; it **coupled the 4 GRPO samples**:
+- SGLang promotes prefill-only to full deterministic inference server-side
+  (`_handle_deterministic_inference` in
+  [server_args.py](/sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang/srt/server_args.py) sets
+  `enable_deterministic_inference = True`), which switches sampling to seeded
+  Gumbel sampling (`multinomial_with_seed` in
+  [sampler.py](/sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/sampler.py):
+  noise = murmur(seed, position, token)).
+- Miles only sends a per-sample `sampling_seed` when
+  `args.sglang_enable_deterministic_inference` is set
+  ([sglang_rollout.py](/root/miles/miles/rollout/sglang_rollout.py),
+  `GenerateState`/`generate_and_rm_group`). The prefill-only CLI flag does not set that
+  Miles-side attribute (`validate_args` in
+  [arguments.py](/root/miles/miles/backends/sglang_utils/arguments.py) mirrors it only for
+  `recompute_logprobs_via_prefill`/`true_on_policy_mode`).
+- With no seed sent, SGLang defaults **every** request to seed 42
+  (`SamplingBatchInfo.from_schedule_batch` in
+  [sampling_batch_info.py](/sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang/srt/sampling/sampling_batch_info.py)).
+All 4 samples of a prompt therefore share the same Gumbel noise at every position; with
+identical logits they emit identical tokens. Each sample *marginally* is still a correct
+draw, so train/rollout log-prob agreement (abs-diff, k3) looks fine or better — exactly the
+dashboard picture — while 83–94% of groups have zero reward variance (healthy: 31–38%)
+and GRPO gets almost no signal. Note full `--sglang-enable-deterministic-inference` does
+**not** have this bug: Miles then sends seeds `rollout_seed + 0..3` per group member
+(confirmed by screening it: independent pairs, worst match statistic in the healthy range).
+## The rule
+Groups are rebuilt per dump file by exact prompt-token equality (the dumps have no group
+id; `sample_indices` is just 0..N−1). Only generated tokens (`loss_mask == 1`) are used;
+tool-response and template tokens are excluded everywhere (their engine log-prob is a
+placeholder 0). A *segment* is one contiguous generated run (one assistant turn).
+**Clause A — group independence (the incident signature).**
+For each pair of samples in a group, take their common prefix of generated tokens and
+compute `S` = sum of the trainer log-probs of those shared tokens (the larger of the two
+samples' sums, i.e. the conservative direction). Under independence, `exp(S)` is exactly
+the probability that the second sample reproduces the first sample's tokens that far, and
+`P(S < −x and matched) ≤ e^{-x}` per pair regardless of model, prompt, or entropy.
+Hold if more than 2 pairs have `S < −20` (per-pair bound 2e−9; at ~1500 pairs/run the
+false-hold probability is <1e−5). Healthy screens: worst pair over 6,144 pairs was
+−7.3. The prefill-deterministic screen: 1,270/1,536 pairs below −20, median −73,
+worst −1385. Long *verbatim* agreement is **not** itself the alarm — easy prompts
+legitimately produce token-identical 300–600-token trajectories (observed in healthy
+runs) — agreement *through tokens the model itself rates uncertain* is. That is what `S`
+measures, and it is why raw duplicate counting or zero-variance-group counting cannot be
+the gate: both fire on healthy low-entropy prompts, and zero-variance also rises
+legitimately as training improves pass rate.
+**Clause B — gross distribution corruption (backstop).**
+Pooled over generated tokens, hold if the fraction with
+`|logp_train − logp_rollout| > 1` exceeds 2%, or with `|Δ| > 2` exceeds 0.5%
+(non-finite log-probs count as `|Δ| > 2`). These limits are 4–18× above the worst
+tolerated configuration measured (see table); they exist to catch catastrophic breakage
+(corrupted state/weights, garbage sampling), not to adjudicate small numeric differences.
+**Clause C — first-turn corruption.**
+Hold if the fraction of first-segment generated tokens with `|Δ| > 0.5` exceeds 1%.
+In every healthy/tolerated run the first turn is nearly exact (worst 0.14%, most runs
+exactly 0 of ~80k tokens), because it conditions only on the prompt; a change that breaks
+even this stratum is broken everywhere, and pooling alone would dilute it (first segment
+is ~17% of tokens).
+Missing/unreadable dumps, no generated tokens, or no same-prompt groups ⇒ hold
+(fail-closed: the recipe guarantees 4 samples per prompt, so their absence means the
+input is not what the check was built to verify).
+## Why there is no fine-grained mismatch gate
+Per-token mismatch in the tolerated family is a continuum with no separable gap.
+Token-weighted mean `|Δ|` over full 8-step lr-0 screens: prod 0.013–0.015,
+TP2 0.018, full-deterministic 0.022, mixed-chunk 0.022, SSM-fp16 0.024, KV-fp8-e5m2 0.033,
+int8-mamba-checkpoint 0.038 — while MTP/NEXTN speculative is *below* prod (0.0074, zero
+tokens with `|Δ| > 0.5` in 500k) and the coupled prefill run sits mid-pack (0.016).
+Every candidate summary (mean/quantiles of `|Δ|`, k3, tail rates at 0.25/0.5/1/2,
+per-turn strata, per-sample means) orders these the same way and puts known-good
+configurations (deterministic, TP2 — semantics-preserving by construction) inside the
+lossy family's range. Any threshold fine enough to hold int8/KV-fp8 would, on a different
+seed or prompt mix, hold deterministic/TP2: the two prod seeds already differ 1.45× on
+`|Δ|>1` rate with identical prompts. Meanwhile the baseline demonstrably learns at the
+prod mismatch level (dashboard), and pass@1 at lr 0 is flat across the whole family
+(0.32–0.39). Small mismatch is a variance/efficiency tax GRPO already pays; it is not
+the fidelity cliff. The dashboard panel fails both ways for the same reason: it averages
+`|Δ|` over tokens (blind to coupling, which leaves marginals untouched) with step-level
+sampling noise of the same size as the effects it would need to rank.
+Two related non-clauses, deliberately:
+- **Top-p 0.98 passes.** Its only dump signature is a deficit of very-low-probability
+  sampled tokens (frac with trainer p<0.001: 0.16% vs 0.49–0.56% healthy); all Δ
+  statistics are at prod level (mean `|Δ|` 0.0155). The induced per-token KL
+  (≈ E[−log(nucleus mass)] ≤ 0.02, typically far less) is the same order as the tolerated
+  numeric family, and a tail-mass reference test would not survive production runs, where
+  a few training steps move policy entropy (and hence tail mass) by more than the top-p
+  effect. It is also a first-class Miles sampling parameter, not an engine infidelity.
+- **Pass rate / response length are not gated.** They move with prompt mix, seed, and
+  training progress, and the incident run's pass@1 (0.32) was in the healthy band.
+## Calibration (lr-0 screens, 8 steps × 32 prompts × 4, seed 1 unless noted)
+`imp` = pairs with S<−20 (of 1536); tails = pooled generated-token fractions.
+| run | verdict | imp | worst S | \|Δ\|>1 | \|Δ\|>2 | seg0 \|Δ\|>0.5 |
+| prefill-deterministic | **hold (A)** | 1270 | −1385 | 0.21% | 0.07% | 0 |
+| deterministic (full) | pass | 0 | −7.3 | 0.32% | 0.10% | 0 |
+(Queue screens run on this box via `/app/queue/run_screen.sh`; dumps in `/app/runs/`.)
